name: Consecutive Close-Above-Prior-High Exhaustion
note: Counts consecutive bars whose close exceeds the PREVIOUS bar's high -- a strictly stiffer test than an up close, since the whole prior range was engulfed -- and shorts the first bar the streak reaches its threshold, optionally only beneath a 200 EMA. One entry per streak: the signal fires on the bar the counter crosses the threshold and never while it merely stays there. Covers on the first close beneath the previous bar's low.
source: StockSharp/AlgoTrading, strategy API/1601-1700/1601_Consecutive_Close_High1_Mean_Reversion -- 'counts consecutive closes above the prior high and sells once the count reaches a threshold; position exits when price falls below the prior low; optional 200 EMA filter'
